description:
Search Gene Ontology terms by GO ID.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_go — one record = one direct GO annotation record of one gene.
Key: id, go[].id, go[].aspect, go[].evidence, go[].source, go[].geneProduct, go[].ecoId (go[].ecoId may be null).
Results: ranked by gene_count desc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one direct GO annotation record of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.go_membership` counts go_memberships; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.term` counts terms.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Direct GO annotations, not propagated.

aspect.description: C: cellular component; F: molecular function; P: biological process.

query.description: A case-insensitive substring search: every stored value containing the text is pooled into the results and counted in `_vbt.total`.
